summary.text: A car pulls forward out of darkness, its low engine rumble building as it emerges into faint light.

description.text: The target begins in near-total darkness, with no readable horizon and only a faint sheen of ambient light catching the front edge of a car. The vehicle is almost a silhouette at first, its body melding into the black surroundings, while a low engine rumble is already present and builds from near-silence. As the shot advances, the headlights and grille gradually resolve out of the darkness, and the car starts to roll forward. The ground beneath is dark pavement, readable only through a soft, broken reflection along the front edge; the surrounding space stays uncluttered and deep black. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening on the emerging front of the car without losing the surrounding darkness. The motion is restrained: the car shifts from an almost invisible shape into a discernible, forward-moving form, and a faint tire roll becomes audible beneath the engine.
A low engine rumble rises from near-silence, with a faint tire roll on pavement beneath it.
A thin sheen of light catches the front edge of the car; the headlights and grille begin to resolve from black.
The car starts to roll forward, its silhouette gaining shape as it leaves the deepest black.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

At the cut, the car continues pulling forward and clears the deepest shadow. Its body and headlights are now fully visible in dim ambient light, with the front fascia, grille and headlamp shapes readable against the surrounding dark. The car advances toward the camera at a steady pace, holding a continuous low engine rumble and the sound of tires rolling forward on pavement. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing more of the dark paved ground and the car's clean forward trajectory while keeping the background uncluttered. Light slides across the hood and front edge as the vehicle emerges, making the forward motion legible; the silhouette that dominated the opening becomes a fully present car that keeps its steady roll. No extra action distracts from the single movement: the car simply comes out of the dark and continues forward.
The engine rumble holds steady as the tires roll forward on pavement.
